title: Worksheet 9: Keeping Your Account Secure
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: An account's password is one of the most important tools for keeping a Roblox account safe from being accessed by someone else. A strong password should be different from passwords used on other websites or apps, should not include easy-to-guess information like a birthday or pet's name, and should never be shared with anyone, including friends, since sharing a password removes control over who can log in and make changes. If another player somehow gains access to an account, they could change settings, spend real money on items, message other players while pretending to be the account owner, or even lock the real owner out completely. Roblox also offers a security feature called two-step verification, which requires entering a special code, usually sent to an email or phone, in addition to a password before logging in, making it much harder for someone else to access the account even if they somehow learned the password. Turning on two-step verification is one of the simplest ways to add an extra layer of protection to an account.
